lessons_used: Preset customization fallback flow during adoption was helpful (+8.0%), though a carousel fallback flow later showed no clear effect.
Interactive wait screen tips and status was helpful (+5.1%), but other wait screen updates (progress bars, notification alerts, status screens) showed no clear effect.
Desktop pet control callout card during the finish step significantly hurt performance (-13.9%), while other finish step changes (copy, verification screens, layout) showed no clear effect.
Sign-in changes (hints, step reordering, single-column layout) and redesigns during path selection or adoption showed no clear effect.
Predictions consistently overestimate measured impact, particularly for expected positive changes.

picked: Waiting Screen Background Rendering Timer Info

decisions.title: Waiting Screen Background Rendering Timer Info

lessons_next: Preset customization fallback flow during adoption was helpful (+8.0%), though another fallback flow later showed no clear effect.
Interactive wait screen tips & status was helpful (+5.1%), but other wait screen updates (progress bars, alerts, status screens, timers) showed no clear effect.
Story screen sequence reordering before path selection was helpful (+2.9%), though sign-in reordering showed no clear effect.
Specific copy changes can significantly hurt performance (desktop pet callout card -13.9%, adoption certificate ownership copy -7.7%), while other copy and layout changes showed no clear effect.
Sign-in changes (hints, layout, step order) and visual redesigns during adoption or path selection showed no clear effect.
Predictions consistently overestimate positive impact, but underestimated the story screen sequence reorder (predicted -1.0%, measured +2.9%).
